title: Tech and the Internet
focus: 软件, 账号, 密码, 隐私, 数据, 人工智能, 网速, 更新, 系统, 设置, 备份, 卸载, 安装, 信号, 短视频, 直播, 算法, 截图, 登录
body:
Phones, apps and the internet come up in almost every adult conversation, but family Chinese rarely covers them. These are the words you need to talk about accounts, settings, data and online life, plus the verbs for fixing a misbehaving phone.

## Words

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 软件 | ruǎnjiàn | software / app |
| 账号 | zhànghào | account |
| 密码 | mìmǎ | password |
| 隐私 | yǐnsī | privacy |
| 数据 | shùjù | data |
| 人工智能 | réngōng zhìnéng | artificial intelligence |
| 网速 | wǎngsù | internet speed |
| 更新 | gēngxīn | to update |
| 程序员 | chéngxùyuán | programmer / software developer |
| 系统 | xìtǒng | system |
| 设置 | shèzhì | settings |
| 备份 | bèifèn | to back up |
| 卸载 | xièzài | to uninstall |
| 安装 | ānzhuāng | to install |
| 充电器 | chōngdiànqì | charger |
| 信号 | xìnhào | signal |
| 短视频 | duǎnshìpín | short videos |
| 直播 | zhíbō | livestream / to livestream |
| 算法 | suànfǎ | algorithm |
| 黑客 | hēikè | hacker |
| 病毒 | bìngdú | virus |
| 截图 | jiétú | screenshot / to take a screenshot |
| 链接 | liànjiē | link |
| 注册 | zhùcè | to register / sign up |
| 登录 | dēnglù | to log in |
| 内存 | nèicún | phone storage / memory |
| 互联网 | hùliánwǎng | the internet |
| 网络 | wǎngluò | network / internet connection |

## Which word?

- **更新 vs 升级**: 更新 is a routine update (更新App, 更新数据). 升级 is moving up to a new version or level (系统升级, 会员升级).
- **网络 vs 网速 vs 信号**: 网络 is the connection itself (网络断了 the connection dropped). 网速 is its speed. 信号 is phone reception from the tower.
- **账号 vs 账户**: 账号 is what you log into. 账户 is where money sits (银行账户).
- **注册 vs 登录**: 注册 creates the account once. 登录 is every time you sign in.
- **安装 vs 下载**: 下载 gets the file onto the phone; 安装 sets it up. The opposite of 安装 is 卸载.

## Examples

- 我忘了密码，得重新设置一下。 wǒ wàng le mìmǎ, děi chóngxīn shèzhì yíxià: I forgot my password, I need to reset it
- 现在的App都在收集用户隐私。 xiànzài de App dōu zài shōují yònghù yǐnsī: Apps these days all collect users' private data
- 这里网速太慢了，视频一直卡。 zhèlǐ wǎngsù tài màn le, shìpín yìzhí kǎ: The internet here is so slow, the video keeps freezing
- 手机提示我更新系统。 shǒujī tíshì wǒ gēngxīn xìtǒng: My phone is telling me to update the system
- 换手机之前记得先备份。 huàn shǒujī zhīqián jìde xiān bèifèn: Remember to back up before you switch phones
- 这个App太占内存，我卸载了。 zhège App tài zhàn nèicún, wǒ xièzài le: This app took up too much space, so I uninstalled it
- 他每天刷两个小时短视频。 tā měitiān shuā liǎng gè xiǎoshí duǎnshìpín: He scrolls short videos for two hours every day
- 算法老给我推同类的视频。 suànfǎ lǎo gěi wǒ tuī tónglèi de shìpín: The algorithm keeps pushing the same kind of videos at me
- 别乱点链接，小心中病毒。 bié luàn diǎn liànjiē, xiǎoxīn zhòng bìngdú: Don't click random links, you might get a virus
- 我登录不上去，是不是密码错了？ wǒ dēnglù bú shàngqù, shì bú shì mìmǎ cuò le: I can't log in, is the password wrong?

cards.Example: 这个软件很好用。 zhège ruǎnjiàn hěn hǎoyòng: This software is really easy to use
cards.Notes: Phone apps are usually just called App or 应用; 软件 is the general word for software.

cards.Example: 我的账号被盗了。 wǒ de zhànghào bèi dào le: My account got stolen
cards.Notes: 账户 is a bank or financial account; 账号 is a login account (WeChat, email, games).

cards.Example: 我忘了密码，得重新设置一下。 wǒ wàng le mìmǎ, děi chóngxīn shèzhì yíxià: I forgot my password, I need to reset it
cards.Notes: Also the PIN for a bank card. 改密码 = change the password.

cards.Example: 现在的App都在收集用户隐私。 xiànzài de App dōu zài shōují yònghù yǐnsī: Apps these days all collect users' private data
cards.Notes: Collocations: 保护隐私 protect privacy, 侵犯隐私 invade privacy, 个人隐私 personal privacy.

cards.Example: 数据都备份了吗？ shùjù dōu bèifèn le ma: Has all the data been backed up?
cards.Notes: 大数据 = big data. 流量 is mobile data allowance, not 数据.

cards.Example: 人工智能会取代很多工作。 réngōng zhìnéng huì qǔdài hěn duō gōngzuò: AI will replace a lot of jobs
cards.Notes: In casual speech many people just say AI (A-I).

cards.Example: 这里网速太慢了，视频一直卡。 zhèlǐ wǎngsù tài màn le, shìpín yìzhí kǎ: The internet here is so slow, the video keeps freezing
cards.Notes: 卡 = to lag / freeze, very common in speech: 手机好卡.

cards.Example: 手机提示我更新系统。 shǒujī tíshì wǒ gēngxīn xìtǒng: My phone is telling me to update the system
cards.Notes: 升级 = upgrade to a new version or level; 更新 = refresh with the latest content or patch.

cards.Example: 他在一家互联网公司当程序员。 tā zài yì jiā hùliánwǎng gōngsī dāng chéngxùyuán: He works as a programmer at an internet company
cards.Notes: Self-mocking slang: 码农 (code farmer).

cards.Example: 系统出了问题，今天没法下单。 xìtǒng chū le wèntí, jīntiān méifǎ xiàdān: The system's having problems, we can't place orders today
cards.Notes: Also an organizational sector: 教育系统 the education system.

cards.English: settings (on a phone or app) / to set
cards.Example: 你在设置里把通知关掉就行。 nǐ zài shèzhì lǐ bǎ tōngzhī guāndiào jiù xíng: Just turn off notifications in settings
cards.Notes: The Settings menu on Chinese phones is literally 设置.

cards.Example: 换手机之前记得先备份。 huàn shǒujī zhīqián jìde xiān bèifèn: Remember to back up before you switch phones
cards.Notes: Also a noun: 做个备份 make a backup.

cards.Example: 这个App太占内存，我卸载了。 zhège App tài zhàn nèicún, wǒ xièzài le: This app took up too much space, so I uninstalled it
cards.Notes: Opposite: 安装. 删掉 (delete) is the casual way to say it.

cards.Example: 先安装这个软件，再注册账号。 xiān ānzhuāng zhège ruǎnjiàn, zài zhùcè zhànghào: Install this software first, then sign up for an account
cards.Notes: 下载 = download, 安装 = install. Also for equipment: 安装空调.

cards.Example: 你带充电器了吗？我手机快没电了。 nǐ dài chōngdiànqì le ma? wǒ shǒujī kuài méi diàn le: Did you bring a charger? My phone's almost dead
cards.Notes: 充电宝 = power bank; 数据线 = charging cable.

cards.Example: 地铁里没信号。 dìtiě lǐ méi xìnhào: There's no signal in the subway
cards.Notes: 信号不好 = bad reception.

cards.Example: 他每天刷两个小时短视频。 tā měitiān shuā liǎng gè xiǎoshí duǎnshìpín: He scrolls short videos for two hours every day
cards.Notes: 刷 = to scroll through: 刷视频, 刷手机, 刷朋友圈.

cards.Example: 她晚上在网上直播卖衣服。 tā wǎnshang zài wǎngshàng zhíbō mài yīfu: She livestreams in the evenings selling clothes
cards.Notes: 直播带货 = selling products by livestream; 主播 = streamer / host.

cards.Example: 算法老给我推同类的视频。 suànfǎ lǎo gěi wǒ tuī tónglèi de shìpín: The algorithm keeps pushing the same kind of videos at me
cards.Notes: 推 / 推荐 = recommend, push (content).

cards.Example: 公司的服务器被黑客攻击了。 gōngsī de fúwùqì bèi hēikè gōngjī le: The company's servers were attacked by hackers
cards.Notes: 被黑了 = got hacked (spoken).

cards.Example: 别乱点链接，小心中病毒。 bié luàn diǎn liànjiē, xiǎoxīn zhòng bìngdú: Don't click random links, you might get a virus
cards.Notes: 中病毒 uses zhòng (4th tone), like 中奖.

cards.Example: 你截个图发给我。 nǐ jié ge tú fā gěi wǒ: Take a screenshot and send it to me
cards.Notes: Separable verb: 截个图, 截了一张图.

cards.Example: 我把链接发你微信上了。 wǒ bǎ liànjiē fā nǐ wēixìn shàng le: I sent you the link on WeChat
cards.Notes: 点链接 = click a link.

cards.English: to register / sign up (for an account)
cards.Example: 注册要用手机号。 zhùcè yào yòng shǒujīhào: You need a phone number to sign up
cards.Notes: 注册 = sign up (first time); 登录 = log in.

cards.Example: 我登录不上去，是不是密码错了？ wǒ dēnglù bú shàngqù, shì bú shì mìmǎ cuò le: I can't log in, is the password wrong?
cards.Notes: 退出登录 = log out.

cards.Example: 我手机内存满了，拍不了照了。 wǒ shǒujī nèicún mǎn le, pāi bù liǎo zhào le: My phone storage is full, I can't take photos anymore
cards.Notes: Technically RAM, but in speech it's used for storage too. 存储空间 is the formal term.

cards.English: the internet (as a concept or industry)
cards.Example: 互联网改变了我们的生活方式。 hùliánwǎng gǎibiàn le wǒmen de shēnghuó fāngshì: The internet has changed the way we live
cards.Notes: Say 网上 for 'online' in daily speech; 互联网 for the internet as an industry: 互联网公司.

cards.Example: 今天网络不太稳定。 jīntiān wǎngluò bú tài wěndìng: The connection is a bit unstable today
cards.Notes: 网络 = the connection or network; 网速 = how fast it is.

cards.Pinyin: zhèlǐ de Wi-Fi mìmǎ shì duōshao
cards.Notes: Passwords and numbers are asked with 是多少, not 是什么.
重启 = restart / reboot; 关机 = shut down; 开机 = turn on.
